note.en: Card "Supported modalities": input text + image, output text; ViT-G/14 perception encoder; audio not supported; video processed frame-by-frame (not optimized for video). Verified via the hf-mirror.com mirror (the origin page is region-blocked).

note.zh: 模型卡：Reliable Tool Use——跨多轮长流程按 schema 可靠调用函数；工具失败会诊断并重试。经 hf-mirror 镜像核实。
note.en: Card: "Reliable Tool Use" — schema-based function calls across extended multi-turn workflows; failed tool calls are diagnosed and retried. Verified via the hf-mirror.com mirror.
